question: What capacity retention did the anode-free full cell show after 1000 cycles?
expect: not reported: the full cell is shown over 40 cycles; 1000 cycles are plating/stripping tests (p4.L13-14, p5.L48-50)
trap: reporting the 1000-cycle plating CE as full-cell retention
